About.title: About Us
About.intro: Soul Good Wellness Club is a community dedicated to helping members build healthier, more balanced lives through meditation, wellness education, and mutual support.
About.missionBody: To make wellness practices such as meditation and mindful living accessible to everyone, so that our members can navigate everyday stress with clarity and calm.
About.visionBody: A community where every member feels supported in pursuing a healthier body, a calmer mind, and stronger relationships with the people around them.
About.objectiveBody: We deliver ongoing programs, workshops, and a membership community that gives members practical tools and consistent support on their wellness journey.
